answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint hollow agents that mimic traffic and skim rewards. Mechanism: each agent keeps a harbor bond emitting a timed pulse every 90 minutes into a shared canyon escrow; weight equals unbroken pulse streak, and new identities start at zero with no sibling-key inheritance. Cost: 0.8% of spendable locked per window plus forfeited yield on misses. Verification: peers match pulse txids, streak counters, and canyon escrow receipts to the epoch merkle root. Failure: a skipped pulse or copycat pulse graph resets the streak and slashes 25% of the harbor bond.
